# Suggestion

Suggestion: a chip for a value or question the system proposes, which a person accepts or leaves.

Also asked as: ai chip.

**Import:** `import { Suggestion } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/labels/Suggestion/Suggestion.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/labels/Suggestion/Suggestion.stories.jsx` — Types, InATagRow, Callbacks, StateLayers, FocusRing, DisabledBesideTags, AcceptIntoTags, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Disabled

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/labels/Suggestion/Suggestion.mdx`

**Motion:** enter `appearance.fast` · exit `spatial.fast` + `appearance.fast`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `Suggestion` when the system proposes a value and a person decides whether
to take it: an AI-suggested focus area beside the ones already chosen, or a
suggested question beside a chat box. Put it in the row where the accepted
value will land, after the tags already there.

### Type guidance

| Type | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Insert | The default. Adds a value to the field, in place; `onAccept` hands back the `value`. Leads with a plus. Example: "Fractions". |
| Prompt | Sends or fills text, starting a conversation; `onAccept` hands back the `text`. Leads with a sparkle wand. Example: "Summarize". |

Use `Tag` for a value that is already in the field. Use `Button` for an action
that is not a proposed value.

## Motion

Suggestion reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| enter | Swap content in place | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Fades in place. |
| exit | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Accepting folds it away; dismissing fades. |

## Best practices

### Name the action. {#name-the-action}

Name an insert suggestion for its value. Start a prompt label with a short verb
and pass the full request as `text`.

Do: A short verb.
Don't: A sentence in the chip.

### Pick insert or prompt by outcome. {#pick-insert-or-prompt-by-outcome}

Insert changes the content in place; prompt starts a conversation.

Do: Insert for an in-place edit.
Don't: Prompt for an in-place edit.

### Show an unavailable action as disabled. {#show-an-unavailable-action-as-disabled}

Keep unavailable suggestions visible and disabled. `isDisabled` disables one;
a disabled field or `TagGroup` disables all through `TagContext`, shared with Tag.

Do: Disabled when unavailable.
Don't: Active with nothing to do.

### Let the field decide what happens next. {#let-the-field-decide-what-happens-next}

`onAccept` returns the value (insert) or text (prompt). The field adds a Tag,
sends a message or fills the text box, then removes the suggestion; the suggestion
does not change itself.

Do: Insert hands back the value; the field turns it into a Tag.
Don't: A Tag styled as a suggestion is not a button, so nobody can accept it with a keyboard.

## Accessibility

- **A real button.** It takes focus, and Enter or Space accepts it.
- **Disabled is a disabled button.** It keeps its name, is announced as
  disabled, is skipped by Tab, and never calls `onAccept`.
- **Named for what pressing it does.** An insert suggestion is announced as
  `Add {label}, suggested`, so a screen-reader user knows pressing it adds a
  value. A prompt is not added to anything, so it is announced as
  `{label}, suggested`.
- **The glyph is decorative.** The plus and the sparkle wand are hidden from
  assistive technology; the name already says what the suggestion does.
- **Focus is a ring, not a fill**: a 2px Focus Ring 2px outside the edge, so
  focus never reads as pressed.

## Related

- For a value already in the field, use `Tag`, inside a `TagGroup`.

Same group: `AiMessage` · `ChangeTag` · `CountTag` · `DateTag` · `PromptStarters` · `SmartTag` · `StatusTag` · `Tag` · `TagGroup`

## Parts

1. **Glyph.** A plus for an `insert` suggestion, a sparkles wand for a `prompt`. It says which kind of proposal this is.
2. **Label.** The proposed value or prompt, short.
3. **Edge.** Dashed, in the discovery border: the system proposed it, the person has not accepted it.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | A dashed edge on a clear ground. The accessible name is "Add Fractions, suggested" or "Summarize, suggested". |
| Hovered | `--ds-background-discovery`. |
| Pressed | `--ds-background-discovery-hovered`. |
| Focused | A 2px ring 2px off the dashed edge. The ground stays clear, so focus never reads as pressed. |
| Disabled | Disabled ground and words, no focus, and `onAccept` never fires. A disabled field or tag group disables every suggestion in it. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Edge | `--ds-border-discovery`, dashed, `--border-default` wide. |
| Words and glyph | `--ds-text-discovery` and `--ds-icon-discovery`. |
| Hovered, pressed | `--ds-background-discovery` and `--ds-background-discovery-hovered`. |
| Focus ring | `--ds-border-focused`, `--focus-ring-width` wide and offset. |
| Disabled | `--ds-background-disabled`, `--ds-text-disabled`, `--ds-icon-disabled`. |
| Box | The same height (22), padding (`--pad-x-xs`) and radius (`--radius-md`) as Tag, so it fits the row where the value will land. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use the value itself: "Fractions". | Write an instruction: "Click to add Fractions". |
| Keep a prompt to a few words that read as a request: "Summarize". | Send a whole paragraph as the label. |
| Offer a few. Three to five fit a row. | Fill a row with suggestions until the real tags are lost. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | string (required) | — | The proposed value's words. The accessible name is built from it. |
| `type` | enum | `'insert'` | `insert` adds a value to the field; `prompt` sends or fills text. |
| `value` | any | — | `insert` only: what `onAccept` receives. Defaults to `label`. |
| `text` | string | — | `prompt` only: the text `onAccept` receives. Defaults to `label`. |
| `onAccept` | func | — | Called with the value (insert) or the text (prompt), then the click event. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | — | Disables this suggestion. A disabled field or TagGroup disables all of its suggestions through `TagContext`. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Fires on press, before `onAccept`. It never replaces `onAccept`. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `id` | string | — | — |

## Variants

**`type`** — `insert` · `prompt`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
